fixed_corpus_10000.method: Five alternating fresh processes per version; identical frozen input, supplemental words and single-threaded source-copy driver. C CLOCK_MONOTONIC/fork/exec/wait4 measures child wall and peak RSS.

actual_cli.method: Actual frozen release ELF; generate 1 and generate 10000, five alternating fresh processes per version. Default parallel batch path, hardware RNG, UTF-8 BOM and 17 complete output fields checked.

unchanged_web_observation.scope: Fresh browser context per run, localhost HTTP, fixed num64/supp64, module-only. Cold means empty application caches in that new context; OS caches/browser executable remain warm. Cold import and first success precede timed 10k loop. Product plus temporary decoder timing counters and cache-observation export; optional profiling is diagnostic, not a benchmark claim.

limitations: Linux x86_64 native results only; Windows/macOS native tests were not run.
CLI uses hardware RNG and cannot pair input values or expose automatic supplemental word counts; fixed-corpus probes establish exact bits and counts separately.
Five-run medians describe this host. File cache was not evicted; first runs retained; no formal significance claim.
Single-record runs are short and hardware RNG dependent, with overlapping timing and RSS ranges.
Median peak RSS increases of 64 KiB in the fixed probe, 200 KiB in CLI 10000, and 128 KiB in CLI 1 are preserved in this report; memory improvement is not claimed.
Actual CLI 10000 uses the product default parallel batch path; deterministic probe is single-threaded, so their absolute timings are not directly comparable.
Packaging is official deterministic uncompressed TAR plus a supplementary equal-method DEFLATE9 ZIP; archive payload hashes checked.
Web candidate timings and synthetic server delay are not a GitHub Pages deployment measurement.
No browser optimization survived the prespecified acceptance criteria; original web bytes and original performance costs remain.
Final UI checks close the earlier pageerror observation gap but do not replace or relabel the historical full geometry checks.
Nu has an authorized acceptance exception, not a clean raw checker result.
Windows and both macOS targets need native build/tests; the inactive docs workflow is only a proposal.
